install: Fetch each file from raw.githubusercontent.com/<repo>/<COMMIT_SHA>/prompts/<file> at the SAME commit as this manifest; verify sha256; save as a skill named skill_name.

files.description: Desk protocol: the shared rules every bot on the team reads first, every session.
HQ: synthesizes the specialists' evidence into one decision per opportunity, runs the disagreement protocol, writes the daily report and weekly review.
Alpha Hunter: discovery of early, explainable opportunities on Solana, Base and Ethereum.
Smart Money: wallets with a realized, repeatable on-chain record; who's entering and exiting.
Crypto Radar: news, social velocity, macro, catalysts, narratives and the market regime snapshot.
Rug Shield: adversarial security review; an evidence-backed REJECT is a veto that can't be outvoted.
Quant Lab: calibration, signal value, strategy leaderboard, bias control, immutable records, weekly research lab.
Risk & Execution: costs, liquidity, exposure and limits; an evidence-backed REJECT is a veto.

The operating system every bot follows: regime first, evidence-graded research, narrow yes/no scoring, calibration, backtest-to-production pipeline, risk engine, self-improvement that never loosens hard limits.
Locked risk rules, loss ladder and entry bar every bot follows before any trading suggestion or safety audit.
How approved desk decisions are executed from the bot's own capped Coinbase CDP wallet (or sent as move cards in manual mode).
Step-by-step setup of the capped Coinbase CDP Server Wallet engine; nothing trades live without the owner's typed yes.
Full Robinhood trader master prompt (stocks, ETFs, crypto, optional long options): manual mode first, owner-set caps, hard safety limits.
Compact Robinhood rules to read before every trading action, routine run or report: owner-set caps, loss triggers, execution, buy-veto gate.
